statement.zh: 杰姆代特奈斯尔 1920 年代发掘材料见 Matthews 2002；该地名在文献中亦用作晚乌鲁克之后过渡组合/分期标签。此处不断言「最早文字」排名。
statement.en: At Jemdet Nasr, materials from the 1920s excavations are documented in Matthews 2002; the site-name also labels a post–Late Uruk transitional assemblage/period in the literature. Absolute rankings of “first writing” are not asserted here.

editorial.notes: Fact about publication and period naming practice. | Substance tighten 2026-10-12: Tightened: site materials + period label; no primacy.
